lines.text: In spite of all this, they kept on sinning;
despite His wonderful works, they did not believe.
So He ended their days in futility,
and their years in sudden terror.
When He slew them, they would seek Him;
they repented and searched for God.
And they remembered that God was their Rock,
that God Most High was their Redeemer.
But they deceived Him with their mouths,
and lied to Him with their tongues.
Their hearts were disloyal to Him,
and they were unfaithful to His covenant.
He forgave their iniquity and did not destroy them.
and did not unleash His full wrath.
He remembered that they were but flesh,
a passing breeze that does not return.

pictures.scene: Teodor Axentowicz, Feast of Jordan — the people crowded to the blessing of the water as they do every year, in spite of all this they kept on sinning, despite His wonderful works they did not believe
pictures.name: pd_axentowicz_feast_of_jordan

pictures.name: pd_dou_the_quack

pictures.scene: Dirck van Delen, The Pharisee and the Publican — the one standing far off and beating his breast in the great hall, when He slew them they would seek Him, they repented and searched for God
pictures.name: pd_delen_pharisee_and_publican

pictures.scene: Gustave Doré, Scottish Highlands — the bare rock standing over the glen and holding everything up, and they remembered that God was their Rock, that God Most High was their Redeemer
pictures.name: pd_dore_scottish_highlands

pictures.scene: Georges de La Tour, The Fortune Teller — the hands going about their work behind the face that keeps talking, but they deceived Him with their mouths, and lied to Him with their tongues
pictures.name: pd_latour_the_fortune_teller

pictures.scene: Lucas Cranach the Younger, Christ and the Adulteress — the woman brought before the Lord by the men who are sure of themselves, their hearts were disloyal to Him, and they were unfaithful to His covenant
pictures.name: pd_cranach_adulteress_detail

pictures.scene: John Everett Millais, The Rescue — the fireman carrying the children down out of the burning house to their mother, and yet He was compassionate, He forgave their iniquity and did not destroy them
pictures.name: pd_millais_the_rescue

pictures.scene: Jan van der Heyden, De Haarlemmersluis — the gate shut across the water holding back everything behind it, He often restrained His anger, and did not unleash His full wrath
pictures.name: pd_heyden_haarlemmersluis

pictures.scene: Eugène Boudin, The Beach at Trouville — the wind off the sea taking the skirts and the parasols as it goes by, He remembered that they were but flesh, a passing breeze that does not return
